page.notes: Head "Ruff. Tertigon Porphyrioni. LXII." is uncertain: the Greek-derived word after "Tertigon" is hard to read at this scan resolution, and the Greek-style "Porphyrioni" was transcribed as printed. "Vites" and "Lysistrate" are readable but unverified. The paragraph ending "do con-" is cut at the foot of the scan; the continuation is not on this page. The left edge shows show-through from the neighbouring page and is excluded.
